title: Valuation Effects of Norway's Board Gender-Quota Law Revisited
eligible_reason: Event-study abnormal returns around quota announcement dates (Tables 4-6, 9), IV regressions for Tobin's Q (Table 10), and an operating-performance DiD (Table 11) where compliance is fixed at 2008 for all ASA firms (compliance_Fix = 1 if aar >= 2008 & asa == 1) vs. large AS firms. That is a single common date. Tobin's Q panels use institution x year interactions, also common timing. No staggered adoption. No data shipped.
